numerical_contract.accumulation: FP32 native; scalar FP64 independent semantic oracle
numerical_contract.active_key_norm: unit norm in represented FP32 bundle; reader verifies; native kernel does not normalize
numerical_contract.comparison: abs(actual-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference) for every live output and every final-state element
numerical_contract.exceptional_values: active inputs and initial states finite; padding NaNs are excluded from live operation
numerical_contract.gate_range: 0 <= alpha,beta <= 1, includes exact zero and near-one values
numerical_contract.padding: NaN input/reference sentinels only outside each sequence length; output sentinel must remain untouched
numerical_contract.represented_inputs: FP32 keys, values, queries, alpha, beta, and initial state; FP64 independent recurrence outputs/final states serialized in the same bundle
numerical_contract.sequence_contract: all live timesteps in order, preserve nonzero initial state, carry final state across segments, no history truncation or sequence mixing
